Opening statement: Thank you all for joining — I’m announcing that we will close the Northbridge site effective [MM/DD/YYYY]; this decision is final and we will run a short, focused transition to reassign colleagues where possible and provide standard severance, outplacement, and one‑on‑one support for those we cannot place.  
Q: Can this be reversed? A: No — the closure is final; our priority now is a swift, orderly transition and support for impacted employees.  
Q: Why rush this? A: Prolonged uncertainty harms people and the business; a brief, decisive process lets us move colleagues into roles faster and get support to those who need it.  
Q: Will input change the decision? A: You can raise questions today and with HR and your manager, and that feedback will inform individual placement and logistics, but it will not reopen the core decision; Q: How are reassignments decided? A: Managers and HR will match skills to openings based on qualifications and business need using transparent criteria.  
Q: What are the immediate next steps and support? A: HR will share program details and timelines today, managers will begin one‑on‑one conversations this week, and affected employees will receive placement assistance, standard severance if not placed, and outplacement services.
